setup.command: set -e; if ! command -v godot >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -sSL -o /tmp/godot.zip https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64.zip && (cd /tmp && unzip -o -q godot.zip && sudo mv Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64 /usr/local/bin/godot && rm godot.zip); fi; TPL="$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.7.2.stable"; if [ ! -f "$TPL/android_debug.apk" ]; then mkdir -p "$TPL" && curl -sSL -o /tmp/tpz.tpz https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_export_templates.tpz && (cd /tmp && unzip -o -q -j tpz.tpz templates/linux_release.x86_64 templates/linux_debug.x86_64 templates/windows_release_x86_64.exe templates/windows_debug_x86_64.exe templates/web_release.zip templates/web_debug.zip templates/web_nothreads_release.zip templates/web_nothreads_debug.zip templates/android_debug.apk templates/android_release.apk templates/android_source.zip templates/version.txt -d "$TPL" && rm tpz.tpz); fi; if [ ! -d "$HOME/android-sdk/platform-tools" ]; then sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq openjdk-17-jdk-headless >/dev/null && mkdir -p "$HOME/android-sdk/cmdline-tools" && curl -sSL -o /tmp/android-tools.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-13114758_latest.zip && unzip -o -q /tmp/android-tools.zip -d "$HOME/android-sdk/cmdline-tools" && mv "$HOME/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/cmdline-tools" "$HOME/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest" && rm /tmp/android-tools.zip && yes | "$HOME/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" --sdk_root="$HOME/android-sdk" "platform-tools" "build-tools;35.0.1" "platforms;android-35" >/dev/null; fi; pip3 install -q --break-system-packages jsonschema pillow numpy; godot --headless --import --path . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

check.command: python3 tools/validate_content.py && python3 tools/analyze_dialogue.py && python3 tools/audit_arcs.py && python3 tools/validate_assets.py && godot --headless --path . game/tests/TestRunner.tscn && godot --headless --path . game/tests/Playtest.tscn
